_note: PROPOSED bucket ruling (agent, 2026-09-09) -- tier 1 = merges that are functional identities for a KEEP decision. Confirm or edit before the full generation; the scout ran under it. Tiers 2/3 (pod-chain one-ofs merged by mana value) are listed in docs/design/analysis-Melira Pod.md 2026-09-09d and are NOT applied here.

merge.why: Every one of these produces {G} untapped on turns 1-3 (the fast-lands are untapped with <=2 other lands; both Pathways have a green face; Wastes' ping is irrelevant to the keep). For an opener the question is 'can I cast Hierarch/Birds/Melira on curve', and all six answer it the same way.

The deck's only lands with NO green: W/B only. Basilica also enters tapped and bounces, but as a one-of it is its own hand dimension for no keep-relevant reason -- a hand's count of non-green lands is what the decision sees.
Both are free sacrifice outlets (the combo's third piece: Melira/Vizier + persist creature + outlet). One-drop vs two-drop and can't-block vs pump do not change whether the opener holds an outlet.

Vizier is the deck's second copy of Melira for the persist loop (both stop the -1/-1 counter, so Finks/Redcap return forever with an outlet). Same cost {1}{G} vs {1}{W}; the keep sees 'persist enabler in hand'.
One-drop mana creatures; Birds fixes any colour and Hierarch gives {B}{R}{G} plus exalted, but either makes the turn-2 Melira / turn-3 Pod, which is the keep question.
